integrity.reproducibility: The complete analytic argument is in RESULT.md; a standalone Python-standard-library finite checker is in scripts/verify.py.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns independent simultaneous uniform neighbor proposals on the complete residual graph only; it does not describe intermediate or sparse graph densities.
The one-round Poisson limit is previously known and is credited; the claimed additional statement concerns many-round completion time and its pathwise fluctuation law.
The relevant full chapter of a potentially related 2017 randomized-handshake thesis was inaccessible and priority remains subject to independent verification.
Finite rational checks cannot validate an infinite martingale central limit theorem; correctness relies on the explicit analytic proof.
title: Gaussian completion time for synchronous mutual-proposal matching on complete graphs
